snippet.title: OTHERSIDE: Untamed  Words - 2D hand-drawn Metroidvania Coming to Kickstarter
snippet.description:
#metroidvania #2dgames #platformgames #upcominggames #steam #kickstarter #handdrawn
OTHERSIDE is a 2D hand-drawn Metroidvania adventure featuring 'Cat Face' - a hunter awakened from slumber. Wield a sword and brush to explore a beast kingdom, encounter tribes, and uncover secrets.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3846200?utm_source=youtube
Follow on KICKSTARTER: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/othersidecraft/otherside-untamed-words-2d-hand-drawn-metroidvania

Feel free to share! More content in our Press Kit: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/10CBgr9aaXSGUSvcD9ZcvnqrHk9g6VHed?usp=sharing 
Official Website: https://othersidecraft.com
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/anWZd8ztYE
Thanks for your support!

Music by Chaning: @Channing92​
